dialog.title: Reply copilot
dialog.description: Reads the latest messages, judges intent and risk, drafts three replies and ranks them. Review a draft before sending — nothing is sent for you.
dialog.failed: The copilot could not finish. Your input has been kept.

judge.title: Their message
judge.substanceNow: Give substance now — a fact, time or plan ({p}%)
judge.holdingLine: A holding line is enough for now ({p}%)
judge.truncated: Part of the conversation did not fit the local model; the read may be less precise.
judge.backgroundDropped: The endpoint rejected the contact background, so it was left out.

unavailable.no_provider: No decision provider is selected, so the conversation is not judged and drafts are not ranked. Pick one in Settings → Conversation.
unavailable.provider_unavailable: The decision provider is not ready yet (the model may still be loading).
unavailable.not_configured: The decision endpoint is missing a URL, model or key.
unavailable.cors_unreachable: The browser version cannot reach the decision endpoint. Use the desktop or mobile app.
unavailable.not_validated: The selected decision provider has not passed calibration for conversation judgment (the local laya checkpoint scores near chance on it), so this chat is not judged and drafts are not ranked. Use a remote Jev endpoint in Settings → Conversation for this.

skipped.pii: Drafting was skipped: personal data remained after redaction.
skipped.empty: Nothing to reply to yet. Add what you want to say.
skipped.no-output: The model returned no usable replies. Try again.
skipped.no-model: Configure a model to draft replies.

unrankedReason.no_provider: Not ranked — no decision provider is selected.
unrankedReason.not_validated: Not ranked — the selected provider is not validated for ranking replies.
unrankedReason.single_candidate: Only one reply was drafted, so there was nothing to rank.

errors.provider_unavailable: the decision provider is not ready
errors.not_configured: the decision endpoint is not fully configured
errors.invalid_request: the request was rejected as malformed
errors.network: the decision endpoint could not be reached
errors.http_status: the decision endpoint returned an error
errors.cors_unreachable: the browser version cannot reach this endpoint
errors.recursive_provider: a plugin cannot use its own provider

knowledge.summary: Context: {contact} · {memory, plural, =0 {no memories} =1 {1 memory} other {# memories}}
knowledge.noRelationship: No relationship set — add one in the contact profile.
knowledge.memoryUsed: {count, plural, =1 {1 memory used} other {# memories used}}

memorySkipped.disabled: Memory not used (turn it on in Settings → Conversation → Composer assistance).
memorySkipped.pii: Memory not used: the conversation still had personal data after redaction.
